why: On 30 Jun 2026 the Godot Foundation said review was overwhelmed by AI-agent and AI-written pull requests, that vibe-coded submissions are already an auto-ban, and that new contributors need permission before a feature or large refactor. https://godotengine.org/article/contribution-policy-2026/
population_note: Search totals from 2026-10-22. Not a census, and not a count of bad patches.
